label: TRUTH_CONDITIONAL_LANGUAGE_4; logical…: Language: sentences true or false at worlds, with negation…
definition: `Language`: sentences true or false at worlds, with negation, conjunction and disjunction obeying their classical truth conditions. `Language.Entails Γ s`: s holds at every world at which every premise in Γ holds. Sentences are not identified with their truth sets. The standard propositional language is the instance whose worlds are valuations, where this is classical logical consequence.
note: Stipulative: the logic within which every verificationist criterion speaks of 'entails' and 'deducible'. No particular atoms, finiteness or decidability are assumed, so each theorem applies to every such language.
